note: Boone County, NE publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (zoning_map.pdf, based on a 2013 Albion map) and text regulations. The only interactive zoning map found is Albion's 'for reference only' viewer hosted on a third-party vendor (subsurfacemaps.com), which is not a queryable ArcGIS REST service and could not be reached. ArcGIS searches (Hub and Online) returned no Boone County NE zoning service. Hub and PlanningZoningOutlines hits belong to Boone County, Missouri and Kentucky.
